bagPolicy.summary: Only small clutches, wristlets or fanny packs up to 5" x 8" x 1" are allowed. All items are subject to search and measurement.
allowed: Small clutches up to 5" x 8" x 1"
Fanny packs up to 5" x 8" x 1"
Medical equipment bags smaller than 14" x 14" x 6"
Parenting bags smaller than 14" x 14" x 6"
bagPolicy.note: Medical and parenting bags must go through metal detection screening and are subject to a physical search. There are no lockers on site, so prohibited items must go back to your vehicle or be surrendered.

parking.note: Parking availability, access routes, and pricing at Hersheypark Stadium can vary by event. Review the linked official information and reserve in advance when that option is offered.

rideshare.note: A dedicated rideshare zone was not confirmed in Hersheypark Stadium's current published guidance. Follow the event page and your rideshare app on show day, and use only signed pickup or drop-off areas.

concessions.note: Hersheypark Stadium offers a wide variety of food and drink options, including traditional concessions like hot dogs and hamburgers, as well as unique offerings such as Cuban sandwiches and smoked barbecue. Beverage options include a selection of beers, wines, cocktails, and fresh squeezed lemonades.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Accessible parking is located in the Preferred Parking Lot and in the General Parking areas.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in Hersheypark Stadium's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Will Call is located at Hersheypark Stadium Box Office and opens at 9 a.m. on the day of the concert. For guests who may not have credit or debit cards, they can convert cash to prepaid debit cards at the Cash-to-Card kiosks located in the Box Office lobby and on the concourse outside of the Hershey Sports store.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at Hersheypark Stadium. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
